notes.title: V2.0 Update + Changelog
notes.content:
Hello again! As [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/437250/A_House_of_Many_Doors/]outlined in my previous post[/url], A House of Many Doors is finally being updated with much-needed bugfixes and quality-of-life improvements, thanks to the hard work of super-fan Altotas. 

Please note that this update is massive and, as such, [b]it will break existing saves[/b]. If you have an ongoing playthrough you want to preserve, you can switch back to the old version of the game very easily through Steam. Simply right click on the game in your library -> "Properties" -> "Betas" -> select the "compatibility" branch.

Thank you so much to all of you still playing A House of Many Doors. I poured my heart and soul into this game and it's so gratifying to know that there's finally an official polished version out there. Let me leave you with a list of links: 
- If you want even more in-game content, check out Altotas' [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2708670345 ]unofficial patch[/url]! 
- To discuss the new update, [url=https://discord.gg/DWWz5V7ynM]join the HOMD fan Discord.[/url] 
- And if you want to keep up-to-date with my future activities, [url=https://harrytuffs.substack.com/]sign up to my newsletter.[/url]

Finally, here is a full changelog, courtesy of Altotas:

[h2]OPTIMISATION[/h2]

-Proper deactivation of interactable scenery objects
-Texture cache flushing added
-An option to toggle additional Linux support in the main menu (disables some shaders that tend to crash the game for Linux users) 

[h2]UI[/h2]

-Slightly bigger line breaks for text
-Got rid of the practically unreadable small font used in a few places
-Increased transparency of the Notes (was obscuring the left corner of the screen too much)
-More icons for cargo items and various other occasions
-Current date display is lowered slightly and now also shows the region name
-Adjusted UI of the Cargo tab
-An attempt at fixing the scrollbar sometimes falling out of the dialogue box
-Logbook sub-tabs now properly close when you click open the next one (just like the cargo tab already worked)
-Current Crew tab now also shows stats
-Relationships tab was divided into three separate tabs to avoid clutter and visual glitches: Relationships, Reputation and Scrutiny
-Added new Logbook tab for finished concerns
-Rearranged Miscellaneous Event Options so the quest-related ones are always on top. Also, reduced the number of tabs by separating them into categories
-Added "Review the clues about the City of Glass" to the Miscellaneous Event Options
-An option to drink Soporific Draught when you are Sleepless
-While staying at various locations of the House, Miscellaneous Event Options are available under the separate tab called "Inside the kinetopede" to reduce cluttering
-Fixed Sanity bar getting stuck (prevents it from going over 100 or under 0)
-Player name turns red when one wound away from death
-Fixed missing speech bubbles for certain crew members (UI element that shows you can start or progress their concerns)
-"Continue" button now always correctly loads the latest save

[h2]UPPER DECK CREW[/h2]

-When recruiting old friends, you can now see the tag "[Personal concern: Resolved.]" or "[Personal concern: Unresolved.]"
-Recruitment and Room of Memories now properly take into account instances when your crew members leave the team or are missing in action
-All romances properly terminate with your partner’s death or them permanently leaving the crew
-Rearranged the crew dialogue screen so the "Return" button always appears on top
-Fixed Char's bugged romance progression
-Corrected the required payment to Madam Sadie and Ten-a-Penny during Char's concern
-Fixed one of the outcomes during Banjo's event in Waste Disposal
-Fixed Vanch's event in Gandola not giving you the right Expiriences
-Fixed Judith's bugged romance progression
-Fixed a small bug that can be encountered during the last leg of Judith's concern
-A Lonely Firepit's resident never leaves indefinetely, so to not soft-lock Fiona's concern
-Fixed a bugged branch of Nicholas' concern
-Fixed the notorious bug during Harmony's concern that gave you Radical Pamphlet instead of the Box of Terrifying Memories
-Fixed a bugged branch of Rotherford's concern
-Rotherford now has a "Hosting a guest" event ("My first content patch since 2017 lol" - Harry Tuffs)
-Fixed Ransack's bugged romance progression
-The game now remembers if you raised your bet with Bradley or not
-To start Sandy’s concern you now actually need at least one Blinding Hooch, as it was intended
-The long-standing Sandy's soft-lock when you do her concern after a certain event is now fixed by the addition of the short alternative scene
-Missing text added back to Lucetta's recruitment screen
-Fixed an exploit with infinitely obtainable Expiriences during Lucetta's recruitment
-Fixed a repeatable exploit during Bishop's concern
-Small Viola-centric plot hole is rectified

[h2]LOCATIONS[/h2]

-Fix for "Inspection" events not firing consistently
-More expensive lodgings now have access to the new Stash function (with corresponding Logbook tab)
-Taking a month off now also heals your "Maimed" status
-Adjusted prices in shops to make trading a lil bit more profitable and eliminate exploits
-When you buy a kinetopede upgrade, it is then removed from sale. Similarly, if you already bought four weapons of the same kind, you can't buy more of them
-For all kinetopede upgrades, you can read a preview of what they actually do before you buy them
-Fixed Morbazar's Scrutiny that was supposed to be buyable from the Nameless Library
-Banshee weapon is properly available for purchase in Ghoulwatch
-Trepannic Fluid and Scorthidion's Scrutiny are available for purchase in Harlequin
-Shop in MFS now properly reacts to the change of regime in the Chimeric Empire
-Added missing text to Kelp Fortress, Recalcitrance and Calaram shops
-To mitigate the hull damage done to your kinetopede after buying and changing armour, one time free hull repair is available after its purchase
-Fixed "Number Of Times Visited Panomnicon" variable not saving properly (btw this was the reason why "Explorer" achievment wasn't actually achievable for some players)
-Fixed the critically bugged Funghetto event in the City of Keys
-Crossing Tarwater in the City of Engines now actually takes the required 20G out of your pockets
-Fixed a minor inconsistency with Brabazon Bridge event in the City of Bridges
-You can obtain Radical Pamphlets in Cinders Common (City of Angels) or in Harlequin
-Any leftover Sleepless Wretches can be released into the wilds of the Waker’s Respite after certain destructive event
-Fixed preaching events (often used wrong variable flags when checking what god you worship)
-Added an option to take the girl from Brite as a passenger 
-Scavenging in Waste Disposal now actually has a failstate (no more crashing)
-Fixed an absolutely insane bug that gave player 10 apprehensions per second on a particular screen in the Cyrus Institute
-Fixed a repeatable Unique Expirience in Skeleton Party
-Fixed an exploit with repeatable wandering events after save-loads
-Fixed the wrong money requirements for Primordial Oddity in the Howling Pits and other such instances (usually Rest prices and various bribes)
-Slightly increased sanity recovered on rest in various locations
-Fixed Magnum Opus-related bugs
-Writing poetry now allows you to not memorise your poems
-Lady Nyctimene now actually gives you the rare Angelwine bottle in exchange for the Swarm Bomb (instead of the game straight up lying about it in your face)
-Silent Minister needs three Glimpses for one of her mirrors (let's be real, it was too easy before)
-The rotten feast event is fixed (you get Expiriences only first time, and then - only Mind-Shattering Disruptions)
-Electing Ninth Minister won't brake your concerns anymore - alternative scenes were set up for all of them. Descriptions of surrounding locations change accordingly
-Raised the reward from Lady Vadhera Thespian
-Raised the reward for ending the Entomarch War
-To prevent possible soft-lock, when you finish working for Ragged Emperor but don't have stability low enough to finish the main concern of the Chimeric Empire, each neutral biomech kill now decreases the Empire’s stability
-Fixed a bug during Lisshan concern that erroneously deposited Fake Rebel Plans in your pocket, breaking quest logic in the process
-Lisshan concern now properly checks what Plans you currently hold and warns you when you are about to make a descision that'll lock you out of helping the other side, thus making it more transparent for the player
-After Lisshan concern any leftover Plans in your possession should be automatically removed now (just a fail-safe, you will probably never need it)
-Slightly raised the skill check for star theft (makes it a little harder to miss one of the requirements for a "Death's Justiciar" achievement)

[h2]DARK ROOMS[/h2]

-Better texture for the snow background
-Refined collision on many scenery objects
-Increased the probability of crew banter events occuring
-Adjusted the probability of a couple of random events occuring
-Increased the chance of darkness monster encounters
-Fixed the game awarding you with the Bounty Hunter distinction even if you already have it
-Birthday event now actually triggers
-Disabled saving in the dark rooms (because this feature, plain and simple, does not work and can be used as an exploit)
-Fixed all instances of the player slipping through the locked walls of the House
-Corrected internal border coords of some regions (Oddwinter in particular was "spilling over" some assets outside the designated coords)
-Increased the spawn chance of rare region-specific scenery objects in dark rooms
-Adjusted the distance of Navigator's map updates
-Fixed three locations being undetectable by your Navigator
-Added red lights to all concern-related enemies that were missing it

[h2]MIRRORWISE[/h2]

-Fixed various small bugs with mirror travel
-Overburdened mirror travel exploit is fixed
-Mirror travel destinations are arranged into groups by region
-"Number Of Times Visited" variables now properly take into account mirror travel

[h2]COMBAT[/h2]

-Increased crew moving speed
-Increased enemy combatants moving speed
-Increased kinetopede moving speed while in combat
-Increased the speed of projectiles
-Doubled Tyrannic's HP
-Victories now slightly boost your sanity (+10 points), failing to flee slightly reduces it (-5 points)

[h2]AUDIO[/h2]

-Slightly increased the volume of the engine sound when the fastest leg upgrade is equipped
-Shortened pauses between musical tracks
-Halved the EnemyEngineEmitter falloff (the Cathedral Tanks were the worst offenders, still clanking loudly long after vanishing from the screen)

[h2]MISC[/h2]

-Various typos corrected
-"Cruise Control" function and hotkey added ("G" by default, but can be rebinded)
-Small corrections and clarifications for tutorial popups
-Fixed various bugs with Divine Favours and Rewards
-Cobblestone Favour now can be exchanged for three free hull repairs instead of one
-Small increase to the Scrutiny gain during some specific actions 
-Trophy items correctly increase and reduce stats when they are equipped/unequipped
-A certain art error is explained away (sort of)

notes.title: V2.0 Update Incoming!
notes.content:
Greetings, denizens and visitants. I bring some fantastic news to brighten your November.

As most of you may already know, there's an [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2708670345 ]unofficial patch[/url] for House of Many Doors, created by an incredibly talented and hard-working fan named Altotas. The patch fixes a huge number of bugs and adds some new content to the game.

Well, Altotas contacted me behind-the-scenes recently. He has very kindly offered to let me[b] add his bugfixes to the Steam game. [/b](The added content will remain exclusive to the fan patch, though I encourage you to download and try it out!)

What does this mean? Well, on the [b]21st November[/b] - to coincide with the Autumn Sale - I'll be updating the game for the first time in, oh God, 6ish years. A bunch of annoying bugs will finally be fixed, and some quality-of-life improvements will be added as well. Happy exploring!

However, one thing to note is that this update [b]will break your existing saves. [/b]But fear not - if you're currently playing through the game, you can use Steam to opt in to the "compatibility" branch, which contains the old unpatched version of the game.

Huge thanks to Altotas for all their hard work! If you want to chat about the game or thank Altotas directly for their incredible efforts, you're welcome to [url=https://discord.gg/DWWz5V7ynM]join the HOMD fan Discord.[/url] And if you want to keep up with my future games and writing, you can [url=https://harrytuffs.substack.com/]sign up to my newsletter.[/url]

notes.title: The Unofficial Patch
notes.content:
Hello, all. Long time no see!

Apologies for the long absence. I'm just posting to draw your attention to an [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2708670345]unofficial patch[/url] created by a HOMD fan named Altotas. 

This patch restores some content that I had to cut for time, as well as fixing a few long-standing bugs and implementing a number of handy features designed to reduce gameplay friction.

Installing is easy enough - just download, then copy the "data.win" file and "Images" folder to the "Steam\steamapps\common\A House of Many Doors" folder, overwriting the file when asked if you want to do so.

Huge thanks to Altotas for all their hard work! If you're curious what I've been up to for the last few years, feel free to [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/437250/discussions/0/6117591738153141066/]check out their transcript[/url] of the AMA I ran on the HOMD fan Discord.

notes.title: V1.2 Update: All's Well
notes.content:
This momentous update finally fixes all the bugs I know about on Windows, apart from a few lingering and very hard-to-fix ones that are unique to specific machines. (If you have one of these, please let me know.)

Bugs fixed are as follows:

- Fixed dependency issues preventing progress in the Abbas Salem quest.
- Fixed some issues with exploring the Shambles in the Dreams of the Dancing God storyline. This wasn't bugged content, it was just very punishingly difficult and quite badly designed to begin with. I think I must have been very sleep-deprived when I came up with this. Made some simple changes that improve the quest progression tenfold.
- Added a way to sell Sleepless Wretches from your cargo.
- Fixed a minor dependency issue in the procedural Journalism quests.
- Fixed a broken dialogue option in the Morbazar storyline.
- Fixed blank-screen dialogue bug in the Nicholas storyline.
- One of the dialogue options in the Library storyline didn't correctly reward guineas.
- A bug I'd already thought was fixed: Travelling via fetch-mirror to Chimer and failing the skill challenge would sometimes drop you a bit too far north. Turns out this could still happen in very rare cases. Now fixed!

notes.title: V1.19 Update: Rebindable Keys
notes.content:
Hi all,

Sorry for the absence over the last few weeks - I couldn't maintain that bugfixing rate, and I ended up crashing a little. But now I'm back!

The latest HOMD update adds rebindable keys, a much-requested feature. It also fixes a major CTD issue unique to the Mac build of the game which was unfortunately introduced in the V1.18 update.

There are still a few bugs that I wasn't able to fix for this version and that I'm going to work on over the next few days, most notably the Abbas storyline and a few difficult-to-diagnose dependency issues in the Journalism quests. Those should be fixed in the next update. 

I'm looking forward to V1.2 - at that point, I think A House of Many Doors will be fully stable, and I can take a step back for a month or two and start planning new content updates and potentially my next major project after HOMD.

Other minor fixes in this update:

- Fixed a bug at the end of the Banjo storyline.
- Fixed a bug when choosing a certain dialogue option in the Ashen storyline.
- Fixed a random event that didn't properly take a Dangerous Beast (Alive) from your cargo.
- Fixed a bug affecting some systems (not sure how many) where the fuel loss event wouldn't properly trigger.
- Fixed minor issue where you get the wrong item when stealing something from Eld Abrathat.
- Fixed a whole bunch of typos.
- Fixed item requirements in one of the Unnamed Society quests.
- SPOILER: Recalcitrance no longer still has shops after being destroyed.
- Fixed a bug in the Nicholas Verdant storyline.
- Fixed a bug stopping you from gathering news in Fargyle Keep.
- Fixed minor bug preventing you click a dialogue option in one branch of the Trees questline.
- Fixed bug that stops progression when following the Trees questline and attempting to gather materials for the Archbishop.

notes.title: V1.05 Fix For File Deletion Issues
notes.content:
Hello, all.

This build should fix the issue causing file deletion on non-C: drives.

If you're at all interested in the technical issues behind it all, read on:

I'm currently working with a more experienced dev who's kindly agreed to help out. He thinks he's found the root cause. The problem seems to be a bug with Game Maker: Studio.

Apparently GMS is assigning to a pointer a temporary string that gets rewritten and deleted, so when the game exits, it points to an empty string. The engine is trying to remove temporary files, but since it feeds an empty string to find files, it actually ends up trying to remove every file it can find.

We've found a solution: Reverting to an older version of Game Maker where the bug doesn't exist. 

Hopefully this will fix the issue, though I still advise caution until we're 100% sure.

Other miscellaneous bugfixes included in this patch:

- Fixed map error when visiting Gunsmith.
- Fixed blank-dialogue bug when retrieving a sample of tooth retreat.
- Fixed hollow snail CTD.
- Fixed shipwreck interactions.
- Fixed delving quests showing up on map after they're done.

notes.title: V1.05 Fix For File Deletion Issues
notes.content:
Hello, all.

This build should fix the issue causing file deletion on non-C: drives.

If you're at all interested in the technical issues behind it all, read on:

I'm currently working with a more experienced dev who's kindly agreed to help out. He thinks he's found the root cause. The problem seems to be a bug with Game Maker: Studio.

Apparently GMS is assigning to a pointer a temporary string that gets rewritten and deleted, so when the game exits, it points to an empty string. The engine is trying to remove temporary files, but since it feeds an empty string to find files, it actually ends up trying to remove every file it can find.

We've found a solution: Reverting to an older version of Game Maker where the bug doesn't exist. 

Hopefully this will fix the issue, though I still advise caution until we're 100% sure.

notes.title: V1.01 Update: Stability Patch
notes.content:
Hi all,

I've uploaded a new build of A House of Many Doors with some quick hotfixes. These include:

- Fixed a crash-to-desktop caused by player portrait alpha values. This was the bug that had been causing CTDs for most people. It slipped through the cracks of development at the very last minute. With it gone, I expect the game to be much more stable for 80% of players.
- Fixed infinite gambling loop at Clayton's Mill.
- Fixed a CTD when breaking up with Char. Her heart was so broken it killed the game.
- Fixed a CTD in Valeria dialogue.
- Fixed CTD issue with Tutorial tooltips.
- Fixed a problem with the Bandit achievement being rewarded wrongly.
- Fixed an infrequent issue with paused missiles causing CTD.
- Fixed a blank-dialogue issue at Gandola.
- Fixed a blank-dialogue issue at Eld Abrathat.
- Fixed a blank-dialogue issue in the Orchard dream.
- Fixed dependency issues in the Dreams of a Dancing God quest.
- Fixed scrambled dialogue options when speaking to Rotherford.
- Fixed useless dialogue options when you've invited Abbas to your lodgings.
- You can now successfully catch a toxin shark.
- You can now successfully flatter Lady Lucanid.
- You can now sell a living Dangerous Beast to the zoo in Founder's Fire, rather than a dead one (which I imagine would make for a more disappointing exhibit).
- Publishing short-story anthologies will now actually give you money, unlike real life.

If you've been experiencing errors at the end of combat, with the crash log mentioning a "lighting engine," you're in a small but understandably frustrated group of people whose PCs seem to have some incompatibility with the game. I've added something that I hope is a fix: Please switch your Combat Graphics in the Options menu from "Normal " to "Compatible." This should work for the moment - however, if not, please let me know. In the meantime, I'll do some work to find the root cause of the issue.

Over the coming few days I'll also do some work to improve the laggy map. I'll let you know when I post the update that improves this.

Final note: Your progress on the Magnum Opus decreasing every time you work on it is not a bug. :)

I hope you've been enjoying the game and can forgive this rocky start. I'm a one-man development team, and though I've been testing the game as much as I can for months, some bugs have obviously slipped through the cracks before release. This is no excuse, of course, which is why I've been working steadily to address your issues. This build is much more stable, and I hope most people's issues have been resolved.
